senses.sense_definition: Iemand die te water is geraakt en dreigt te verdrinken.

examples.text: De dappere omstanders slaagden erin om de <w>drenkeling</w> op het droge te trekken.

target_lang_translations.en: The brave bystanders managed to pull the <w>drowning person</w> onto dry land.

examples.text: De reddingsbrigade zocht urenlang naar een vermiste <w>drenkeling</w> in de wilde zee.

target_lang_translations.en: The rescue squad searched for hours for a missing <w>drowning victim</w> in the wild sea.

target_lang_definitions.en: Someone who has fallen into the water and is in danger of drowning.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: someone actively in danger of drowning
someone who is drowning or has drowned
someone cast away or lost at sea
